title: Stop Copy-Pasting CSV Files. Use Power Query From Folder #shorts
description: Combine matching CSV files with Excel Power Query From Folder. Import through Data > Get Data > From File > From Folder, inspect the sample, then refresh when new matching files arrive. Adding a file does not schedule a closed Excel workbook to refresh by itself. #excel #powerquery #csv #automation #shorts

captions.text: Still copying CSV files one by one?
Data → Get Data → From File → From Folder.
Combine matching files into one table.
Add a matching file, then run Refresh.
No more repeated copying. Refresh still has to run.

visual_note: Illustrative Excel UI; real documented menu steps, no claim of automatically scheduled refresh.
